title: Hues and Cues: Human vs. CLIP

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating the board game 'Hues & Cues' to compare human color associations with the CLIP model's predicted colors for 34 specific words. The chosen colors are mapped onto a CIE xy chromatic diagram and statistically evaluated using the multivariate Hotelling test to identify alignment deviations, such as a Western-centric preference for lighter colors when prompted with the word 'SKIN'.
